extraction_instructions: The /events/ hub is an index of ~13 event-series pages, not a dated list. Each series page holds the current year's event as prose with the date in a sentence (ordinal days, weekday lists, often no year); some series have one level of sub-pages (IR Juniors -> NIRS/RiiSE, Webinars -> Upcoming webinars). The extractor crawls hub -> series -> sub-pages, takes the first non-deadline date line per page and fees from the page's Register link (BSIR page or the CIRSE meeting site).

Server-rendered calendar shows one year at a time as date_row rows (dates, title link, location); the extractor reads the current view plus the next two /date/<YYYY>/ pages. Rows are BMFMS, RCOG and third-party meetings. Detail pages are thin (date, place, prose); fees are on the external organiser site linked from 'Further details' / 'Book online'.

Four server-rendered listings merged: short-course carousel cards, Winter/Summer meeting pages found from the hub (fees on /booking-rates/), the 'Upcoming webinars' bullet list and the third-party 'Other respiratory courses' table. Future meetings (next 18 months) come from the meeting-dates page. Course pages have a Fees block.

DNN site; three server-rendered listing modules (conferences, courses, webinars) whose div.article blocks hold title, link and a date footer ('Loading more' is vestigial, TotalCount equals the blocks present). Stale or missing card dates (Annual Conference, undated webinar) are re-read from the detail page's Date line; on-demand courses are skipped. Detail pages: Date / Venue / CPD labels plus a Members / Non-members pricing tab (ex VAT).

Single Hubble-CMS page of div.teaser cards (title link, one-line intro such as 'A two day in person event', start date + time). No pagination. Event pages give Date:/Location: lines and a 'More details'/'Book now' link; BAPM's own conference registers on a public CFS/EventsAir page whose fee list is parsed. Mixed BAPM and external events.

Preside/Eventfolio site; the calendar lists every upcoming event as article.eventfolio-calendar-event (date range, title link, type badge, city, CPD, Free/External badges); filters and result counter are JS-only and there is no pagination. Detail pages have an event-header block (date, venue lines), a ticket-price widget and a Book Now link to the organiser. Flagship meeting fees are in a PDF on a sub-page.
